[CR CR0368r1 for 38.101-3] Reason for change: Some NR V2X section numbers have been denoted with suffix C. It was agreed that all NR V2X sections numbers will be denoted with suffix E. Also,in some instances the cross-referencing between NR V2X sections in 38.101-3 and 38.101-1 is not correct and needs to be fixed. Summary of change: All NR V2X sections have been denoted with section numbers with suffix E. the cross-referencing between NR V2X sections in 38.101-3 and 38.101-1 has been fixed Consequences if not approved: NR V2X sections will not have consistent section numbering. Also, the cross referencing between NR V2X sections in 38.101-3 and 38.101-1 would be incorrect.
